## Working session summary

All seven requests from issue #13 are done in PR #14 (https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/pull/14), which is now ready for review. The 430 tests, lint checks and build pass locally, and the CI run on the last commit passed.

1. **Rain scaled up too much in Safari.**
   - **Cause:** Safari can run the page scripts before the stylesheet is applied (WebKit bug 261655). The rain and starfield canvases then measure the default 300×150 size. When the CSS arrives they grow to fill the window, but the window itself didn't resize, so nothing redraws them. They stay stretched ×4.27 on a 1280 px window.
   - **Fix:** `src/visuals/size.js` now watches each canvas's own size, so they redraw when the stylesheet arrives.
   - **Verification:** `experiments/rain-scale.mjs` reproduces the bug in Chromium by loading the stylesheet late (×4.27 before, ×1 after). I couldn't test in Safari itself.
2. **Settings page:** `/settings/` is linked from the footer and has 70 options. Every change shows at once in the page and its background, and choices are saved in localStorage. You can reset one setting, a section or everything, and copy or load the changes as JSON. The defaults equal the site's old values, so nothing changes for a visitor who doesn't touch them.
3. **Liquid glass skin:** 16 settings, including blur, tint, edge light, sheen and floating panels. The refraction effect only works in Chromium-based browsers; others get the blur without it.
4. **Futuristic skin**, after konard/immortality: 17 settings, including 12 colour palettes, 8 frame shapes and 9 surfaces.
5. **"Show only real references":** off by default. For 1–4 links it shows 1, 16, 729 and 65,536 networks instead of 4, 81, 4,096 and 390,625.
6. **Associative stack:** it now starts from `link-foundation/meta-theory` and has 13 layers with 191 repositories, plus an index of the layers. It includes all 183 original repositories of linksplatform, link-foundation and link-assistant, each exactly once; a test fails if a new one isn't placed. `link-foundation/lfs` was created after the last data collection, so I collected its data and added it.
7. **L → L² or R → R²:** a setting switches the whole family of formulas everywhere they appear. L → L² stays the default.

The case study is in `docs/case-studies/issue-13/README.md` and is listed in the README. The PR description has before/after screenshots for each item. The leftover `.gitkeep` is removed. There were no comments or reviews on the issue or the PR.
